title: After-battle straighten resets walking animation state, not player facing direction

1_exact_formal_assertion.whole_line: - 善后（结果， 可败）：全队中毒个体的状态计数清零（剧毒计数变常规）；Mega/Primal 显式还原（此善后与濒死路径才有，普通换下不解除——引用 WP41 分层）；有伙伴时治疗玩家全队并治疗/还原伙伴全队；负/平且可败时全队治疗并等待 0.25 秒；触发「战斗结束」；玩家转向正前。
1_exact_formal_assertion.scope: Only final player-facing phrase; other poison/shape/registered-partner/loss healing/wait/end-event statements stay intact.

2_complete_source_units.content:
def after_battle(outcome, can_lose)
    $player.party.each do |pkmn|
      pkmn.statusCount = 0 if pkmn.status == :POISON   # Bad poison becomes regular
      pkmn.makeUnmega
      pkmn.makeUnprimal
    end
    if $PokemonGlobal.partner
      $player.heal_party
      $PokemonGlobal.partner[3].each do |pkmn|
        pkmn.heal
        pkmn.makeUnmega
        pkmn.makeUnprimal
      end
    end
    if [2, 5].include?(outcome) && can_lose   # if loss or draw
      $player.party.each { |pkmn| pkmn.heal }
      timer_start = System.uptime
      until System.uptime - timer_start >= 0.25
        Graphics.update
      end
    end
    EventHandlers.trigger(:on_end_battle, outcome, can_lose)
    $game_player.straighten
  end

def turn_generic(dir)
    return if @direction_fix
    oldDirection = @direction
    @direction = dir
    @stop_count = 0
    check_event_trigger_after_turning if dir != oldDirection
  end

  def turn_down;  turn_generic(2); end
  def turn_left;  turn_generic(4); end
  def turn_right; turn_generic(6); end
  def turn_up;    turn_generic(8); end
